description:
Job Description

The Senior Engineer is responsible for the activities related to an assigned organizational element, program, project, or task. The role normally plans, conducts, and supervises engineering design reviews and analysis assignments involving major projects or several smaller or less complex projects. These projects, by their complexity and difficulty, require fully competent application of conventional knowledge in a specific engineering discipline.

What You Will Do

  • Provides day-to-day leadership of Engineering staff assigned. Assigns projects to other Engineers and monitors the progress of all assigned projects.
  • Ensures the delivery of high-quality service and maintenance of good customer relations. May perform detailed engineering review of plans for compliance with applicable Rules, Standards, Regulations, and contract requirements.
  • Devises new approaches to problems encountered and recommends changes in methods, procedures, or design where necessary.
  • Monitors the technical quality, content, consistency, continuity, and timeliness of action of all assigned projects.
  • Applies intensive and diversified knowledge of engineering principles and practices in broad areas of technical responsibility. Performs engineering reviews and analyses when necessary. Reviews other Engineers’ work and provides appropriate guidance and training when assigned and when necessary.
  • Advises assigned staff in matters related to applying Rules and Regulations.
  • Prepares written responses to clients in accordance with established procedures.
  • Maintains liaison with other engineering specialists internally and externally.
  • Monitors assigned engineers’ performance, development potential, and training needs. Keeps management informed of manpower needs.
  • Develops or assists in developing qualification statements, proposals, bids, and other presentation materials.
  • Implements and maintains the Company’s Quality System within assigned areas of responsibility.
  • Prepares accurate billing for clients.

What You Will Need

  • Bachelor's degree or recognized equivalent in structural, civil engineering, or naval architecture.
  • Should have at least eight (8) years of experience in an appropriate technical discipline and/or industry.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • Be familiar with Finite Element Analysis software packages (FEMAP/Nastran preferably) and expertise in structural analysis in offshore/marine industry.
  • Knowledge of related technical disciplines.
  • Knowledge of applicable Rules and Regulations and the impact of Rule applications and interpretations.
  • Knowledge of company business policies and procedures.
  • The human relations skills necessary to maintain positive client contacts and provide mentorship and motivation to subordinate staff and peers.
  • Ability to communicate effectively orally and in writing.
  • Ability to identify, analyze and solve complex or unique engineering problems.
  • Ability to undertake short- and long-term planning to provide for efficient and effective scheduling of work assignments.

Reporting Relationships

The incumbent generally reports to a Department Head or Manager but may report to others depending on the specifics of the assignment. There are no direct reports for this position.

About Us

We set out more than 160 years ago to promote the security of life and property at sea and preserve the natural environment. Today, we remain true to our mission and continue to support organizations facing a rapidly evolving seascape of challenging regulations and new technologies. Through it all, we are anchored by a vision and mission that help our clients find clarity in uncertain times. ABS is a global leader in marine and offshore classification and other innovative safety, quality, and environmental services. We’re at the forefront of supporting the global energy transition at sea, the application of remote and autonomous marine systems, cutting‑edge technical solutions, and many more exciting advancements. Our commitment to safety, reliability, and efficiency is ever‑present, guiding our clients to safer and more efficient operations.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer, Growth - Contract
description:
At Roofr, we’re obsessed with our customers. We constantly gather feedback to shape, prioritize, and launch the products they truly need. That’s what makes Roofr’s CRM special. We started by building essential sales tools like aerial roof measurements and digital sales proposals. But when our customers asked for a simple, affordable way to manage and scale their entire businesses, we listened. So, we created a CRM that connects these solutions—along with payments, material ordering, and more—into a seamless, powerful platform. With a clear roadmap ahead, we’re excited to continue expanding and leading the market with innovative products.

We have an amazing culture, strong financials, and best-in-class company metrics. It’s an exciting time to be part of an extraordinary startup that is already successful, yet still early enough to offer its team significant growth, equity, and the opportunity to make a real impact.

What You'll Get to Do:

  • Drive cross-product impact: Work across multiple product domains simultaneously—building experiments in Proposals, optimizing onboarding flows, and developing features that directly impact acquisition, monetization, and retention metrics
  • Move fast, responsibly: Operate in a Kanban environment where priorities shift based on experiment results and business needs, requiring you to balance rapid iteration with quality engineering practices
  • Own end-to-end user journeys: Build features that span the entire customer lifecycle—from signup and onboarding to subscription upgrades and hand-offs to implementation teams
  • Pioneer AI-driven experiences: Develop and iterate on novel AI-enhanced workflows and experiments that represent the cutting edge of roofing industry technology
  • Lead with autonomy: Work in a self-directed environment with our product designer and Growth EM, taking ownership of product decisions and driving features from conception to delivery
  • Build with experimentation in mind: Rapidly set up A/B tests and feature variations, prototype new experiences to drive user value, and help us learn and iterate on growth strategies with measurable business impact
  • Develop full-stack solutions: Build performant React components and work with Laravel backend following DDD patterns to create robust, scalable features that maintain code quality while enabling rapid experimentation
  • Make pragmatic trade-offs: Know when to optimize for speed vs. complexity, always considering the unique needs of cross-domain features and growth experimentation
  • Shape the future of roofing software: Join a small, passionate team where your individual contributions directly influence product direction and company growth trajectory

What You'll Bring to the Role:

  • Strong full-stack foundation: 5+ years of experience with JavaScript, React, and backend development (preferably OOP with Laravel/PHP), with 2+ years building scalable, multi-tenant SaaS products that serve real users
  • Database expertise : Strong PostgreSQL skills including query optimization, indexing strategies, and performance tuning for multi-tenant SaaS applications
  • Growth engineering mindset: Experience building for experimentation and metrics-driven iteration, with a track record of breaking down complex problems into testable proofs-of-concept and rapid experiments
  • Cross-functional collaboration: Proven ability to work effectively with marketing, product, and design teams, consistently communicating technical tradeoffs to meet both user needs and business requirements
  • Autonomous problem-solving: You’re comfortable with ambiguity and scoping solutions independently, while knowing when to collaborate. You thrive in early-stage environments where priorities shift and individual ownership drives real impact
  • User-centered: You’ll have a deep belief that great products serve users while growing the business, with experience building accessible, reliable experiences that earn customer trust
  • A focus on quality: You value testing and documentation as much as code, and excel at making smart tradeoffs between complexity and speed to ship the right things quickly
  • Curiosity: A genuine motivation to move metrics and grow the business through thoughtful product decisions, not just technical execution

Bonus Points:

  • Direct experience on a growth team or working on acquisition/monetization initiatives
  • Data-driven mindset with curiosity about user analytics and behavioural patterns
  • An eye for visuals. Design skills aren’t required, but you can think critically about existing designs
  • Experience building AI workflows in production, or the curiosity to learn
  • Experience with A/B testing tools (Google Optimize, Optimizely, VWO, etc.)

What we offer (US + Canada)

When you join our team, you’re not just accepting a job. You’re making a career move. Here’s how we’ll support you in doing some of the most impactful work of your career:

title: Strategic Pursuit Lead
description:
Our Company
Changing the world through digital experiences is what Adobe’s all about. We give everyone—from emerging artists to global brands—everything they need to design and deliver exceptional digital experiences! We’re passionate about empowering people to create beautiful and powerful images, videos, and apps, and transform how companies interact with customers across every screen.
We’re on a mission to hire the very best and are committed to creating exceptional employee experiences where everyone is respected and has access to equal opportunity. We realize that new ideas can come from everywhere in the organization, and we know the next big idea could be yours!

Role Purpose

The Strategic Pursuit Leader (SPL) is the transformation architect and executive deal leader responsible for driving Adobe’s largest and most strategic enterprise pursuits (>$10M). SPLs sit at the intersection of sales excellence, transformation leadership, and executive storytelling – orchestrating Adobe’s full ecosystem, including partners and consulting firms, to deliver measurable business outcomes for customers.

SPLs are expected to operate as Adobe’s elite transformation sellers – the best salespeople, transformation leaders, and storytellers in the company – defining how Adobe sells enterprise transformation in an AI-first, partner-enabled world.

Mission

To lead a repeatable, scalable, and disciplined pursuit program that drives Adobe’s long-term revenue growth and customer transformation through AI-enabled, partner-aligned, cross-cloud solutions – acting as the single source of truth and accountability for all strategic pursuits in the $10M+ deal band.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead Transformation, Not Transactions:
    1. Serve as the executive strategist and deal owner for enterprise-scale pursuits. Partner with customer executives to define a North Star transformation vision that connects business outcomes, AI strategy, and Adobe’s capabilities. Translate complex enterprise change into measurable business impact.
  • Command the Pursuit Business:
    1. Own the qualification, strategy, and execution of each $10M+ pursuit. Drive forecast accuracy, pipeline health, and deal velocity with precision and urgency. Lead pursuit planning and orchestration across Sales, Product, Finance, Legal, Professional Services, and Partners.
  • Orchestrate the Ecosystem:
    1. Mobilize Adobe’s internal and external ecosystem – including Deal Desk, Legal, Product, Consulting, Partners, GSIs, and agencies – to deliver unified pursuit execution. Build trusted relationships with consulting firms and hyperscalers to co-create transformation strategies that scale.
  • Master Storytelling & Executive Engagement:
    1. Craft and deliver C-suite-level transformation narratives that inspire confidence and action. Present Adobe’s AI-first story through compelling storytelling that integrates creativity, data, and intelligence. Be recognized as a thought leader on digital transformation and enterprise value realization.
  • Drive Industry, Partner & AI Expertise:
    1. Maintain deep understanding of assigned industries, partner ecosystems, and AI adoption trends. Leverage customer and partner insights to shape differentiated value narratives. Stay ahead of market evolution through continuous learning and engagement with Adobe’s AI and partner teams.
  • Exhibit Leadership & Enablement Excellence:
    1. Demonstrate consistent participation in the SPL Mastery Curriculum, enablement programs, and cross-functional sessions. Model accountability, preparation, and composure. Lead by example and mentor peers through field shadowing, retrospectives, and co-led pursuits.
  • Contribute to SPL Brand & Thought Leadership:
    1. Represent Adobe’s transformation leadership both internally and externally. Contribute to LinkedIn thought leadership, industry storytelling, and customer transformation showcases. Elevate Adobe’s reputation through professional visibility and partnership engagement.

Required Experience & Attributes

  • 10+ years in enterprise software, SaaS, or consulting with consistent quota attainment on $10M+ opportunities.
  • Proven ability to lead multi-year, multi-stakeholder digital transformation engagements.
  • Executive presence – credible with C-suite leaders across business, IT, and partner ecosystems.
  • Deep understanding of enterprise sales methodology, value-based selling, and outcome-based commercial structures.
  • Strong knowledge of AI trends, partner ecosystems, and consulting firm collaboration models.
  • Exceptional communication and storytelling skills – able to simplify complexity and inspire confidence.
  • Comfortable managing ambiguity, high-stakes negotiations, and accountability across cross-functional and partner teams.
  • Industry specialization or AI solution familiarity preferred (e.g., Retail, Financial Services, Healthcare, Manufacturing, Technology).

Cultural Anchors

Think Boldly. Operate with Precision. Lead from the Front.

SPLs model accountability, presence, and composure – elevating those around them and redefining what transformation selling looks like at Adobe. They focus where it matters, move with urgency, execute with precision, and lead from the front.

  • Estruturar e operar o recrutamento por área (corporativo, conteúdo/transmissões e produtos, comercial, operações) com poucas etapas e papéis claros;

  • Comunicar status, prazos e riscos das vagas para o negócio e registrar aprendizados do que funcionou;
  • Zelar pela experiência do candidato e por práticas de diversidade e inclusão;
  • Desenvolver a coordenação (Talent Ops: dados/ATS/treinamento) com objetivos claros e coaching.

Requisitos Necessários

  • Experiência sólida em TA com volume e mudança de estágio (já organizou processo e fez o ATS trabalhar a favor);
  • Capacidade de planejar e priorizar, negociar com gestores com base em dados;
  • Execução forte em sourcing e triagem; escrita objetiva para contatos;
  • Conforto em ler funil e decidir (pipeline, tempos, motivos);
  • Excel avançado;
  • Comunicação direta e habilidade de formar/treinar equipe (player-coach);
  • Inglês avançado/funcional;
  • Diferencial: vivência em mídia, esportes ou operações com picos/eventos.

Diferenciais desejáveis

  • Implantação de ATS moderno com scorecards e planos de entrevista.
  • Structured hiring e treinamento de entrevistadores.
  • Recruiting Ops: automações simples e painéis (Sheets/Looker/Metabase).
  • Sourcing avançado (busca booleana, mensagens curtas) e talent pool ativo.
  • Vivência com picos/eventos e mix de áreas (corporativo, comercial, conteúdo/ops).

Nossa cultura
Na LiveMode, nossa missão é Transformar e Crescer o Esporte , e nossos valores são o combustível que nos move no dia a dia. Acreditamos que crescer exige inconformismo, ambição e consistência. Nossa cultura nasce disso: de gente que não aceita o que está aí, que quer fazer mais, aprender mais e entregar mais — sempre com responsabilidade e visão de futuro. Quem está na LiveMode está aqui para marcar a história do esporte no Brasil e no Mundo.
SOMOS EMPREENDEDORES ontem, hoje e sempre
Escolhemos o gol e corremos atrás dele com tudo. Focamos em poucas prioridades e vamos até o fim, sem distrações. Tratamos cada recurso como se fosse nosso, decidindo rápido e com coragem. Comunicação? Direta, aberta e na velocidade do jogo.
SOMOS UM TIME DE ALTA PERFORMANCE não uma família ou a confraria de amigos
Família a gente não escolhe, mas o time escolhe quem joga. E quando o jogo é grande, não dá pra carregar quem não tá entregando. Aqui, a gente decide pelo que é melhor pra empresa, não pra uma área ou pessoa. Toda entrega tem um dono claro, que vai até o fim. Processos ajudam, mas não mandam: quem resolve são as pessoas.
SOMOS AMBICIOSOS pensamos sempre grande
A gente já fez muita coisa grande. Mas quem está na LiveMode sabe que dá pra ir além. Porque quem é ambicioso de verdade vive com a sensação de que sempre dá pra melhorar, crescer, fazer mais impacto. Aqui, a ambição não é discurso. É prática. E é ela que nos leva a quebrar recorde atrás de recorde.
O QUE NOS MOVE É O FUTURO Na LiveMode, o futuro já está em movimento — e quem não acompanha, fica pra trás. Por isso, tratamos tecnologia com urgência: testamos, aprendemos e aplicamos com velocidade. Queremos ser uma empresa IA first, porque acreditamos que dominar essas ferramentas não é opcional — é o que vai nos ajudar a alcançar nossa missão mais rápido. IA não é extra. É parte central do nosso dia a dia.

title: Repórter - Tribunais Superiores
description:
Sobre o Bastidor Somos um veículo criado em **** por Diego Escosteguy com a missão de iluminar os segredos do poder. Nossa matéria-prima são notícias exclusivas e de alto impacto, seja por meio de informações sintéticas, seja por meio de reportagens profundas. Cobrimos assuntos e casos difíceis, que envolvem grandes personagens da vida política e econômica nacional. Praticamos jornalismo independente e apartidário com rigor profissional, mediante investigação crítica de fatos de interesse público. Valorizamos trabalho em equipe, apuração constante junto a fontes humanas e uso avançado de ferramentas digitais e de IA para obtenção, checagem e análise de fontes documentais.

Sobre a vaga Procuramos um repórter para cobrir, in loco, os tribunais superiores em Brasília, sobretudo Supremo Tribunal Federal e Superior Tribunal de Justiça. Experiência é desejável, mas não é o mais importante; buscamos talentos que tenham disposição para aprender e vontade de se tornar um grande repórter. Nossa cobertura de STF e STJ envolve tanto movimentos de bastidor e articulações por nomeações no Judiciário quanto acompanhamento de processos relevantes - sempre sob a supervisão de nossos editores.

Responsabilidades

  • Monitorar pautas (plenário/turmas), ler petições, votos, ementas e acórdãos.
  • Acompanhar liminares, pedidos de vista e movimentação processual (PJe, jurisprudência).
  • Mapear litigância estratégica de empresas, políticos e setores.
  • Construir e manter fontes (gabinetes, advocacia, PGR/AGU, academia, sociedade civil) com ética.
  • Produzir reportagens explicativas e investigativas com documentação sólida.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com editores e colegas para desenvolver pautas próprias e séries investigativas.
  • Usar ferramentas digitais/IA para triagem, verificação e organização de materiais.

Requisitos (obrigatórios)

  • Graduação em Jornalismo (concluída).
  • Domínio da Língua Portuguesa (clareza, lógica, gramática e edição).
  • Técnicas básicas de apuração; leitura cuidadosa de documentos jurídicos.
  • Conhecimento básico do funcionamento de STF e STJ (pautas, ritos, institutos).
  • Predisposição para construir e preservar fontes com ética e responsabilidade.
  • Independência e apartidarismo; julgamento editorial equilibrado.
  • Espírito crítico, curiosidade intelectual, trabalho em equipe e abertura a feedback.
  • Conforto com planilhas e pesquisa em bases públicas; disposição para aprender IA.

Diferenciais (não obrigatórios)

  • Formação/experiência em Direito ou cobertura de tribunais superiores.
  • Noções de pesquisa jurisprudencial e leitura de dados de litigância.
  • Inglês de leitura.

O que você aprenderá no Bastidor

  • Técnicas avançadas de reportagem e produção de exclusivas de alto impacto.
  • Pesquisa e obtenção de evidências jornalisticamente úteis (bases públicas e privadas).
  • Análise empírica e lógica de evidências e valoração criteriosa de fatos (epistemologia aplicada ao jornalismo).
  • Redação assertiva, equilibrada e clara, sem clichês, ilações ou hipérboles.
  • Uso avançado de IA e ML para organização, pesquisa e análise de casos.
  • Segurança operacional (física e digital) e proteção de fontes e documentos.

Como se candidatar Envie seu currículo para ****** com "Repórter Tribunais Superiores" e seu nome no campo de assunto. Inclua links para até três reportagens de sua autoria e um texto de até 300 palavras que descreva por que você quer trabalhar conosco.

Summary

The team focuses on enhancing the customer experience on the platform by creating new accounts and migrating existing ones, ensuring information is current and account‑management processes are efficient, providing an optimized user experience.

  • Monitor the team’s service operations.
  • Guarantee that the team follows high‑standards development processes, including PR reviews, code quality, test coverage, robustness, resilience, performance, scalability, security, and responsiveness.

Location

This is a remote position. A remote position does not require job duties to be performed within proximity of a Visa office location. Remote positions may be required to be present at a Visa office with scheduled notice.

Qualifications

  • Based in Brazil.
  • Experience leading a team and building processes.
  • Advanced English proficiency.
  • Hands‑on experience with Java or Golang as well as relational databases.
  • Previous experience with software architecture, microservices, AWS, CI/CD.
  • Experience working with large‑scale/high‑throughput and mission‑critical services.
  • Understand SRE/DevOps, quality, and security concepts.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in the financial industry.
  • Experience with BigData tools such as Spark, Databricks or AWS EMR.

Additional Information

Visa is an EEO Employer. Precisamos de um(a) fornecedor(a) com experiência em criar conteúdos educacionais, sólido conhecimento sobre Bases da IA – conceitos, evolução, tipos e algoritmos aplicáveis. Agro e Transformação Digital – características do agro brasileiro, desafios tecnológicos e iniciativas de inovação. Dados no Campo – fontes (sensores, drones, satélites, sistemas de gestão), tipos de dados, pré-processamento, armazenamento, pipelines de dados e qualidade. Aplicações da IA – pecuária de precisão (monitoramento, saúde, alimentação, produtividade) e integração de tecnologias (drones, IoT, decisões em tempo real). IA Generativa – usos no agro (relatórios, previsões, simulações, assistentes virtuais), modelos disponíveis, ferramentas e limitações. Mercado e Cases – startups, plataformas e resultados alcançados. Ética e Sustentabilidade – uso responsável de dados e automação, impactos ambientais, inclusão digital e desafios regulatórios, clareza na comunicação escrita e capacidade didática.

ENTREGAS PARA ESTA DEMANDA:

Analisar o conteúdo bruto e roteiros para garantir a pertinência temática e a atualidade das informações. Realizar correções de erros conceituais. Propor melhorias para o entendimento do conteúdo. Analisar a linearidade e coesão do texto, adicionando exemplos práticos para facilitar a compreensão e a contextualização. Análise e Otimização Visual (Imagens): Conferir as imagens presentes no material, verificando sua correção, adequação ao tema, público-alvo e contexto. Propor substituições de imagens, se necessário, indicando opções de bancos de imagens ou imagens autorais com boa resolução. Garantir que as imagens selecionadas ou propostas estejam em alta qualidade e resolvam visualmente as necessidades do texto. Garantia de Qualidade e Alinhamento: Validar as atividades e seus feedbacks para assegurar que simulam casos reais e incentivam a tomada de decisão. Validar materiais complementares, confirmando sua adequação ao público-alvo e sugerindo novos, se pertinente. Assegurar que o produto final esteja conforme a expectativa do cliente e do público, com linguagem e visual adequados, conforme especificações do curso. Responsabilizar-se por sinalizar e implementar os ajustes necessários para garantir a integridade e precisão do conteúdo. Conferir e recomendar bibliografia ou material complementar. Capacitação: Realizaremos um momento de alinhamento e capacitação com o validador, para garantir que ele compreenda integralmente as diretrizes pedagógicas, os objetivos do curso e os parâmetros esperados para a atualização. Validação interna da equipe (DI): Após a entrega do conteúdo validado, a DI realizará uma leitura e solicitará os ajustes necessários, assegurando a coerência pedagógica, a aderência aos objetivos de aprendizagem e a qualidade do material produzido. Ajustes e refinamento do conteúdo: Caso sejam identificadas inconsistências ou oportunidades de melhoria, o conteúdo retornará para ajustes por parte da conteudista, seguindo as orientações da DI. Finalização e conclusão da demanda: Com os ajustes finalizados e o conteúdo aprovado internamente, consideraremos a etapa de atualização concluída, encerrando a entrega conforme o escopo previsto no contrato.

PARA PRESTAR ESTE SERVIÇO VOCÊ PRECISA DE:

Expertise nos temas mencionados acima. Desejável experiência em validação de material didático para EaD;

Stadler offers a wide range of international career opportunities. We are looking for motivated individuals who want to shape the mobility of tomorrow with us. Are you ready to achieve great things with us?

The Director of Business Development will lead our sales strategy, focusing on expanding our market presence in the west coast passenger rail industry. This role is not just about selling products but involves understanding the unique needs of our clients, public procurement processes, building long-term partnerships, and contributing to the evolution of public transportation systems. This role requires experience in the rail/rolling stock industry.

  • Develop and execute a comprehensive sales strategy to achieve revenue targets and West Coast market growth
  • Participate in internal and external customer meetings and assigning and following up on action items.
  • Conduct market research to identify trends, opportunities, and competitive dynamics within the passenger rail industry

  • Nurture sales leads in your respective territory, focused on long-term relationship development and management.
  • Plan and advocate for Stadler’s policy priorities in key states such as California.
  • Collaborate across multiple departments and teams to ensure customer requirements are met throughout the design, manufacturing, and delivery processes. Support project management in delivering on time and within budget.
  • Manage and mentor other sales professionals, as applicable, fostering a high-performance culture. Provide guidance and support to ensure direct reports meet their objectives and develops professionally.
  • Represent Stadler at industry events, trade shows, and conferences.

  • Experience in rail/rolling stock is required
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients – in real terms.

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code, but is also passionate about helping end users who are in need of help.

You will design, implement and manage our growing corporate cloud-first infrastructure and networks. You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, as well as be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment. You will need to be a highly motivated, dependable and an experienced technologist who shares our passion and wants to be a part of a fast moving and highly execution-oriented team.

You will work closely with your Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including, but not limited to, Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner who is looking for a supportive environment to continue to grow their IT skills and expertise. This role will report to the Director of IT.

About The Role

You will be customer-facing, and the first line of support; you own support, and you are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees via Slack, Jira, etc. We're all Mac. You are a pro at troubleshooting, using the terminal, and making macOS work in the enterprise. You will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment. You will own the experience of tech onboarding of all new employees as well as tech retrieval of all outgoing employees. You'll design, test, build, and document programs and policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge with your experience and background. You'll support and manage SaaS applications – Google Workspace (GSuite), Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc. You will work with and manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools – MDM, EMM, Jamf, etc. You'll own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.) You'll detail your solutions, craft help articles and automate busywork. Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues as needed, through to completion. You're comfortable juggling help desk tickets and can effectively prioritise them. You'll work on projects over sprints, and detail your work in tools like Jira (you're experienced with agile methods and sprints). You'll set and work to your own objective and key results with minimal direction, and can align them to the team and the company goals.

What You Bring To Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Ability to utilize open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • You are able to integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows in Okta.
  • You know how to work with APIs, and integrate one system to another.
  • You've provided remote support to people in multiple countries, across time zones, and you're familiar with shipping and receiving hardware and customs.
  • Unusually great communication skills across all media — you can make your ideas clear, and you can help people who might be frustrated or time poor without losing your cool.
  • You write very well, whether it's in tickets, email or Slack. You write in a clear, friendly, and concise manner, and are sensitive to different cultures.
  • A desire to provide a magical experience for others — when they win, you win.
  • You take security seriously, and you know what PGP is.
  • You understand networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting — TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching.
  • You must be able to competently and demonstrably know the troubleshooting steps and layers of the OSI model — you know how to methodically troubleshoot problems without wasting someone's time.
  • You can self-manage, and can accurately scope your project, priorities, and work across multiple teams. Strong organisational and task-management skills are critical.
  • You're comfortable dealing with ambiguity, and sometimes making the right decision without all the data.

Nice To Haves

  • Some familiarity with AWS (you will not need certifications, but you will have used these environments a bit.)
  • You've used tools like GAM and command-line interfaces to do lots of work with less effort.
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.

Culture Fit

  • Have a passion for progress by being adaptable and resilient, comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.
  • Have a builder's mindset, excited to create, iterate, and scale IT practices.
  • Be a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.
  • Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts.
  • Have worked in a remote environment before.

A Taste Of What We Provide

  • Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package that starts on your first day!
  • We offer a competitive PTO package that ensures you have the time off you deserve.
  • Ownership in the company. Through shared equity, Ledn employees are stakeholders in the company and the future of the digital economy.
  • We offer every employee the opportunity to work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).
  • A career that provides you with purpose in your job. We remove barriers so you love what you do.

We are an equal opportunity employment organization and pride ourselves on inclusivity, diversity, and the success that comes from diversity. description:

TechnipFMC is committed to driving real change in the energy industry. Our ambition is to build a sustainable future through relentless innovation and global collaboration – and we want you to be part of it. You’ll be joining a culture that values curiosity, expertise, and ideas as well as equal opportunities, inclusion, and authenticity. Bring your unique energy to our team of more than 21,000 people worldwide, and discover a rewarding, fulfilling, and varied career that you can take in anywhere you want to go.

Job Purpose

We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Hedge Accounting Specialist to join our finance team. The successful candidate will be responsible for the end-to-end process of hedge accounting, including derivative instruments analysis, hedge effectiveness assessments, and accounting under ASC 815 (or IFRS 9, as applicable).

Job Description

  • Derivative Instruments Accounting & Analysis: Monitor, account for, and analyze all derivative transactions including forwards, swaps, options, and futures. Ensure proper classification and valuation in accordance with hedge accounting standards.
  • OCI (Other Comprehensive Income) Analysis: Prepare and review OCI entries related to hedge accounting. Analyze fluctuations and report impacts on financial statements.
  • Hedge Cost Allocation: Analyze and allocate hedge costs between business units or cost centers. Track cost of hedging strategies (e.g., forward points, option premiums) and ensure correct accounting treatment.
  • Spot and Forward Points Rate Analysis: Perform in-depth analysis on spot vs. forward points movements and their impact on hedging relationships and financial results.
  • Mark-to-Market (MTM) Analysis: Calculate and explain changes in the fair value of derivative positions. Work with valuation models and external pricing sources.
  • Hedge Effectiveness Testing & Documentation: Execute prospective and retrospective effectiveness tests (qualitative and/or quantitative). Maintain comprehensive documentation for audit and compliance purposes.
  • Collaboration & Reporting: Work closely with Treasury, FP&A, and external auditors to ensure the accuracy and transparency of hedge accounting results. Prepare reports and dashboards as needed for internal stakeholders.
  • Compliance & Controls: Ensure adherence to internal controls and compliance with accounting standards such as ASC 815 or IFRS 9. Support external and internal audits as required.
  • FX Analysis - Conduct detailed Foreign Exchange variance analysis to identify and explain deviations in currency conversion impacts across global transactions enabling data-driven insights.

You are meant for this job if:

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or Economics (MBA is a plus)
  • Experience in hedge accounting, financial reporting, or treasury operations
  • Strong understanding of derivative instruments and financial risk management
  • In-depth knowledge of hedge accounting under ASC 815 and/or IFRS 9
  • Proficient in Excel and financial systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Kyriba, or similar treasury systems)

The impact you will have:

  • Drive system & process improvements : Identify and implement automation or workflow enhancements to reduce manual work, strengthen liability forecasting, and improve scalability.
  • Support month‑end close : Prepare and review accruals, manage prepaid expense amortization, and reconcile accounts payable to ensure accurate, timely, and compliant financial reporting.
  • Partner cross‑functionally : Provide timely, accurate AP reporting and collaborate with stakeholders across Finance, HR, and other teams to ensure a seamless procurement and payment experience.

What we’re looking for:

  • 3–5 years of accounts payable experience, ideally in a SaaS, startup, or high‑growth environment.
  • Strong understanding of AP processes and procurement workflows; experience with Zip, Airbase, Netsuite or similar systems is a plus.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy, with a proven track record of processing payments and invoices reliably and on time.
  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills to identify process gaps, reconcile issues, and recommend improvements.
  • Clear, proactive communicator who builds trusted relationships with vendors and internal stakeholders.
  • Ownership mindset, able to manage multiple AP responsibilities simultaneously while driving continuous improvement.

Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

  • High‑Priority Requests: For P1 items, able to immediately jump in and resolve employee/vendor requests for urgent, time‑sensitive purchases within the same day, without compromising accuracy.
  • Policy Rollouts: When a new procurement or AP policy is introduced, able to implement the change in systems and workflows within 1 week of rollout.

Life at TRM Labs

Leadership Principles

  • Master Craftsperson – We prioritize speed, high standards, and distributed ownership.

Accelerate your Career

At TRM, you’ll do work that matters—disrupting terrorist networks, recovering stolen funds, and protecting people around the world. You will:

  • Work alongside top experts and learn every day.
  • Embrace a growth mindset with development opportunities tailored to your role.
  • Take on high‑impact challenges in a fast‑paced, collaborative environment.
  • Thrive in a culture of coaching, where feedback is fast, direct, and built to help you level up.

What to Expect at TRM

TRM moves fast—really fast. We operate with urgency, ownership, and high standards. As a result, you’ll be joining a team that’s highly engaged, mission‑driven, and constantly evolving.

To support this intensity, we’re also intentional about rest and recharge. We offer generous benefits, including PTO, Holidays, and Parental Leave for full time employees.

That said, TRM may not be the right fit for everyone . If you’re optimizing for work life balance, we encourage you to:

We’re upfront about this because we want every new team member to thrive—not just survive.

The Stakes Are Real

Our work has direct, real‑world impact:

  • Jumping online after hours to support urgent government requests tracing ransomware payments.

Thrive as a Global Team

  • We invest in offsites, regional meetups, virtual coffee chats, and onboarding buddies to foster collaboration.
  • By prioritizing trust and belonging, we harness the strengths of a global team while staying aligned with our mission and values.

Join our mission!

We’re looking for team members who thrive in fast‑paced, high‑impact environments and love building from the ground up. TRM is remote‑first, with an exceptionally talented global team. If you enjoy solving tough problems and seeing your work make a difference for billions of people, we want you here. Don’t worry if your experience doesn’t perfectly match a job description— we value passion, problem‑solving, and unique career paths. If you’re excited about TRM’s mission, we want to hear from you.

title: Hedge Accounting Specialist
description:
Join to apply for the Hedge Accounting Specialist role at TechnipFMC

Job Purpose

We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Hedge Accounting Specialist to join our finance team. The successful candidate will be responsible for the end-to-end process of hedge accounting, including derivative instruments analysis, hedge effectiveness assessments, and accounting under ASC 815 (or IFRS 9, as applicable).

Job Description

  • Derivative Instruments Accounting & Analysis: Monitor, account for, and analyze all derivative transactions including forwards, swaps, options, and futures. Ensure proper classification and valuation in accordance with hedge accounting standards.
  • OCI (Other Comprehensive Income) Analysis: Prepare and review OCI entries related to hedge accounting. Analyze fluctuations and report impacts on financial statements.
  • Hedge Cost Allocation: Analyze and allocate hedge costs between business units or cost centers. Track cost of hedging strategies (e.g., forward points, option premiums) and ensure correct accounting treatment.
  • Spot and Forward Points Rate Analysis: Perform in-depth analysis on spot vs. forward points movements and their impact on hedging relationships and financial results.
  • Mark-to-Market (MTM) Analysis: Calculate and explain changes in the fair value of derivative positions. Work with valuation models and external pricing sources.
  • Hedge Effectiveness Testing & Documentation: Execute prospective and retrospective effectiveness tests (qualitative and/or quantitative). Maintain comprehensive documentation for audit and compliance purposes.
  • Collaboration & Reporting: Work closely with Treasury, FP&A, and external auditors to ensure the accuracy and transparency of hedge accounting results. Prepare reports and dashboards as needed for internal stakeholders.
  • Compliance & Controls: Ensure adherence to internal controls and compliance with accounting standards such as ASC 815 or IFRS 9. Support external and internal audits as required.
  • FX Analysis: Conduct detailed Foreign Exchange variance analysis to identify and explain deviations in currency conversion impacts across global transactions enabling data‑driven insights.

You Are Meant For This Job If

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or Economics (MBA is a plus)
  • Experience in hedge accounting, financial reporting, or treasury operations
  • Strong understanding of derivative instruments and financial risk managementIn-depth knowledge of hedge accounting under ASC 815 and/or IFRS 9
  • Proficient in Excel and financial systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Kyriba, or similar treasury systems)

description:
The Company You’ll Join

Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world-class software, purpose-built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta’s platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence.

Carta’s Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end-to-end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital.

For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.

The Problems You’ll Solve

As an Implementations Project Manager, you will focus efforts on supporting new Investor Services customers in their journey into Carta services. You will drive operational excellence within our fast-growing Investor Services business by coordinating, facilitating and managing on-boarding activities that are critical to achieving success for both our customers and Carta within a tight deadline.

  • Support new Fund Administration, Portfolio Insights, and Valuations' clients by on-boarding them onto Carta – i.e., implementation of client’s limited partners list, investments, capitalization table and securities
  • Extract relevant information from operating agreements and subscription documents to upload limited partners to Carta
  • Analyze data thoroughly and precisely to maintain data integrity throughout the on-boarding process
  • Effectively liaise between sales and Investor Services teams as the bridge post-sales through implementation
  • Coordinate and manage multiple/simultaneous implementation projects by continually communicating with and motivating clients
  • Continuously look for ways to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the on-boarding process
  • Work closely with product and engineering to improve the on-boarding experience for customers

The Impact You’ll Have

You’ll play a critical role in the transformation of the financial services industry through partnering with our new clients and helping them implement our software. In this role you will be responsible for interacting with a fund’s back office (CFO, fund manager) to collect their historical data, provide advisory support, and ultimately deliver accurate data to both the client and internal stakeholders.

About You

From sale close, to implementation, and continued customer success, the ideal Implementations Project Manager will exhibit excellent communication skills, a high degree of problem-solving, velocity, embracing change and will constantly seek ways to better their process to provide customers with a world-class on-boarding experience.

  • Proven success in a project management capacity
  • Ability to interpret a story through unstructured data
  • Experience working with financial data and information
  • Great people skills – high degree of empathy and great communication skills
  • Experience working with clients
  • Experience in implementing and successfully managing small and large projects or initiatives with sustained, measurable success
  • Incredible organizational skills, high attention to detail, and an ability to complete competing priorities quickly and autonomously
  • Passionate, tactical, and direct, with an ambitious attitude and a proven history to go above and beyond baseline requirements
  • Interested in working with enterprise software

Salary

Carta’s compensation package includes a market competitive salary, equity for all full time roles, exceptional benefits, and, for applicable roles, commissions plans. If you are located in New York, New York, our minimum cash compensation salary range for this role is $81,000 - $85,000 (if applicable, + commission). We are hiring for multiple levels and locations, so final offers may vary from the amounts listed based on geography, experience and expertise, and other factors.

Our vision

Everyone who wants a family should have the chance to try. For the 1 in 6 families that struggle to conceive, fertility treatments are an option but they are expensive.   • Have strong interpersonal skills - you’ll constantly be communicating with patients, clinic staff and the rest of our company via email and phone calls.

  • Analisar métricas de desempenho e indicadores de marketing (tráfego, conversão, custo por lead, engajamento, ROI), transformando dados em insights práticos para tomada de decisão.

  • Supervisionar o cumprimento do calendário editorial e dos fluxos de automação, garantindo consistência na comunicação e relacionamento com leads e clientes.
  • Acompanhar os resultados de inbound marketing e funil de conversão, propondo melhorias contínuas para atrair, nutrir e converter leads.

  • Participar ativamente das reuniões de resultado e planejamento com a diretoria, apresentando dados consolidados e novas oportunidades de crescimento.
  • Desenvolver planos de ação tático-operacionais, traduzindo a estratégia de marketing em tarefas concretas para o time e fornecedores.
  • Monitorar a execução do orçamento operacional de marketing, assegurando eficiência e uso estratégico dos recursos.

Principais Objetivos Do Cargo

  • Aumentar o tráfego orgânico do site e blogs da empresa.
  • Gerar leads qualificados B2B e B2C, aumentando as oportunidades de negócio.
  • Elevar o reconhecimento da marca em canais digitais e offline, consolidando a autoridade da empresa no segmento.
  • Aumentar o número de leads pagos e monitorar continuamente o ROI das ações de marketing e comercial.
  • Melhorar a comunicação interna e integração de colaboradores por meio de ações de endomarketing eficazes.

Indicadores de Sucesso (KPIs)

  • Crescimento do tráfego orgânico (visitas e palavras-chave ranqueadas).
  • Taxa de conversão de leads (orgânicos e pagos).
  • Engajamento e alcance das campanhas digitais.
  • ROI das ações de marketing.
  • Cumprimento de prazos e qualidade das entregas.
  • Satisfação e desenvolvimento da equipe de marketing.

Requisitos

Formação em Marketing, Publicidade e Propaganda, Comunicação ou áreas correlatas;

Sólida Experiência comprovada em coordenação de equipes de marketing;

Conhecimento sólido em mídia paga, SEO, marketing de conteúdo e gestão de CRM;

Capacidade de analisar métricas e dados de performance (Google Analytics, RD Station, HubSpot ou similares);

Vivência em planejamento e execução de eventos corporativos e campanhas omnichannel;

Noções de branding, funil de vendas e jornada do cliente;

Habilidade em liderança, comunicação e colaboração interdepartamental (especialmente com áreas comercial e RH).
